description: Source code implementing GNSS NMEA 0183 message parsing, checksum calculation, coordinate conversion, and satellite data handling for a GNSS driver in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: gnss_system_from_gsv_header_args
methods.description: Determines GNSS system type from GSV header message ID.

methods.name: align_satellite_with_gnss_system
methods.description: Aligns satellite PRN and system based on GNSS system type.

methods.name: parse_gsv_svs
methods.description: Parses satellite info from GSV message arguments.

methods.name: parse_gsv_header_args
methods.description: Parses GSV header message arguments into structured data.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for a NMEA message string.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_snprintk
methods.description: Formats a NMEA message with checksum into provided buffer.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_ddmm_mmmm_to_ndeg
methods.description: Converts DDM.MMMM coordinate format to nanodegrees.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_knots_to_mms
methods.description: Converts speed from knots to millimeters per second.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_hhmmss
methods.description: Parses HHMMSS time format into UTC structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_ddmmyy
methods.description: Parses DDMYY date format into UTC structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_rmc
methods.description: Parses RMC NMEA message into GNSS data structure.

methods.name: gnss_nmea0183_parse_gga
methods.description: Parses GGA NMEA message into GNSS data structure.
